problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.notes: sort by start, merge whenever curr.start <= prevEnd — the template every other problem in this set builds on

problems.title: Insert Interval
problems.notes: three-phase linear scan: before / overlapping / after — no need to re-sort since the input is already sorted

problems.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problems.notes: greedy: sort by end time, always keep the earliest-finishing interval, count how many you had to drop

problems.title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
problems.notes: same greedy shape as Non-overlapping Intervals, sort by end — an arrow can pop every balloon it overlaps

problems.title: Meeting Rooms II
problems.notes: min rooms needed = max concurrent overlap; solve with sorted start/end two-pointer sweep or a min-heap of end times

problems.title: Interval List Intersections
problems.notes: two-pointer merge across two already-sorted interval lists; advance whichever interval ends first

problems.title: Car Pooling
problems.notes: interval problem in disguise: a difference array over pickup/dropoff points turns capacity checking into a prefix sum

problems.title: Remove Covered Intervals
problems.notes: sort by start ascending, end descending; track the max end seen so far to detect full coverage in one pass

problems.title: Employee Free Time
problems.notes: flatten every employee's schedule, sort, merge, then read the gaps between merged intervals as the free time
